title: Pager rollback-journal or WAL file accessor

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerJrnlFile exposes the currently open transaction-log file: the WAL file when a WAL owner exists, otherwise the rollback-journal file. This selection is consumed by SQLITE_FCNTL_JOURNAL_POINTER and related VFS integration.
excluded_responsibilities: Opening or closing rollback-journal and WAL files
VFS file-control dispatch after pointer selection

external_source_responsibilities: Pager journal and WAL owners publish and retire their file handles
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete conditional return is assigned. Production sqlite3_file_control operation 28 invokes the accessor rather than reaching through either owner.

outputs: Borrowed open WAL sqlite3_file, borrowed rollback-journal sqlite3_file, or null when neither file is open
contracts.ownership: Pager's WAL or memory-journal owner retains file ownership. The caller must not close, free, or retain it beyond owner lifetime.
contracts.state_and_results: An open WAL file has priority. Without one, an open rollback journal is returned. Otherwise null is returned. No state changes.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O, callbacks, or locking; caller owns Pager serialization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible. Null accurately reports that no transaction-log file is currently open.

representation_differences: The C Wal abstraction supplies sqlite3WalFile(). Zig's typed Wal owner stores the same borrowed sqlite3_file as its optional file field.
The memory-journal owner embeds its source-shaped sqlite3_file and exposes it through abiFile().

oracle.protocol: Open a Pager with neither log, open a rollback journal and compare pointer identity, close it, open/create the WAL file by appending one frame, and compare WAL pointer identity and selection priority.
oracle.normalization: Pointers compare only for identity within one process; null and owner state are exact.

assurance.oom: No accessor allocation; WAL/journal opening OOM belongs to their owners.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or mutation; caller owns Pager serialization.
assurance.malformed_input: Only a live typed Pager is accepted.
assurance.continuation: Accessor calls do not alter either log owner or file position.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig Pager, src/core/wal.zig Wal, and src/core/memory_journal.zig Journal
integration.native_call_path: sqlite3_file_control SQLITE_FCNTL_JOURNAL_POINTER -> Pager.journalFile -> open Wal.file else Journal.abiFile.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The accessor no longer reports only rollback journals and omit an open WAL file.

independent_review.notes: Requires scoped durable public file-control trace promotion and independent review.

known_blockers: Capture a scoped durable SQLITE_FCNTL_JOURNAL_POINTER rollback/WAL receipt before internal-trace promotion.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/pager.c:7159-7169 complete WAL-versus-journal selection was reviewed

src/core/pager.zig journalFile and ownership tests, src/core/wal.zig file opening/lifetime, src/core/memory_journal.zig embedded ABI file, and src/core/sql_frontend.zig file-control dispatch were reviewed
assertions_branches_cleanup: Conditional WAL selection and return block are assigned
Null is retained when neither owner has an open file
Wal.deinit and Journal.close own returned-handle retirement
upstream_tests: Upstream file-control, pager, rollback-journal, WAL, VFS, and close tests exercise this accessor
Project frontend file-control and Pager owner tests exercise null, rollback, and WAL selections
